name: Exp_Slow-Stoch_Duplex
summary: This EA trades a duplex (dual) Slow Stochastic strategy, generating buy signals when the stochastic is oversold and crosses upward, and sell signals when it is overbought and crosses downward. It operates systematically on the Slow Stochastic indicator with configurable overbought/oversold thresholds and applies to any symbol and timeframe. The EA opens positions based on stochastic crossover signals in overbought/oversold zones.
summary_zh: 该EA使用双慢速随机指标策略，在随机指标超卖区向上交叉时产生买入信号，在超买区向下交叉时产生卖出信号。它系统性地基于慢速随机指标的交叉信号开仓，适用于任意交易品种和时间周期。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于慢速随机指标的均值回归原理，认为价格在超买超卖区域会回归均值。入场条件为：当%K线在超卖区（默认20以下）向上穿越%D线时开多单，当%K线在超买区（默认80以上）向下穿越%D线时开空单。出场条件依赖于固定的止盈止损设置，或反向信号出现时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，用户通过Money参数直接设定交易手数。资金管理方面缺乏动态仓位计算，没有基于账户余额或风险百分比的自动调整机制。该策略在震荡行情中表现较好，但在强趋势行情中可能频繁止损。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the mean reversion principle of the Slow Stochastic indicator, assuming that prices in overbought and oversold zones will revert to the mean. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the %K line crosses above the %D line in the oversold zone (default below 20), and a sell signal is generated when the %K line crosses below the %D line in the overbought zone (default above 80). Exit conditions rely on fixed take-profit and stop-loss settings, or closing positions when a reverse signal appears. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach where the user directly sets the trade volume via the Money parameter. Money management lacks dynamic position calculation with no automatic adjustment based on account balance or risk percentage. The strategy performs well in ranging markets but may suffer frequent stop-outs during strong trending conditions.

parameters.name: Price_field
parameters.description: 价格字段（最高最低价或收盘价）

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Overall take profit target in points

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，基于经典随机指标信号，易于理解和验证
使用慢速随机指标减少假信号，相比快速随机指标更稳定
有明确的止损止盈设置，风险可控
超买超卖阈值可调，适应不同市场环境
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic based on classic stochastic signals, easy to understand and verify
Uses Slow Stochastic to reduce false signals, more stable than fast stochastic
Has explicit stop-loss and take-profit settings with controllable risk
Adjustable overbought/oversold thresholds to adapt to different market conditions
cons: 固定手数缺乏动态资金管理，无法根据账户规模自动调整仓位
均值回归策略在强趋势行情中容易连续亏损
没有新增K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
缺少点差过滤和交易时段过滤，可能在不利条件下开仓
cons_en: Fixed lot sizing lacks dynamic money management, cannot automatically adjust positions based on account size
Mean reversion strategy prone to consecutive losses during strong trending markets
No new bar check mechanism, potentially opening multiple positions on the same bar
Lacks spread filter and trading session filter, may open positions under unfavorable conditions
improvements: 增加动态仓位管理，基于账户余额和风险百分比自动计算交易手数
添加趋势过滤器（如均线方向），避免在强趋势中逆势交易
improvements_en: Add dynamic position sizing that automatically calculates trade lots based on account balance and risk percentage
Add a trend filter (e.g., MA direction) to avoid counter-trend trades during strong trends

risk_points: 没有新K线检查，可能在同一K线上重复开仓导致仓位重叠
均值回归策略在单边行情中可能产生连续亏损
固定手数不考虑账户风险承受能力
risk_points_en: No new bar check, may repeatedly open positions on the same bar causing position overlap
Mean reversion strategy can produce consecutive losses in one-directional markets
Fixed lot size does not consider account risk tolerance
